text:
BarlisWedlick Architects is a mid-sized architectural and interior design firm located in New York City and Hudson, NY. We focus on residential architecture, non-residential architecture, interior design, passive house consulting, and comprehensive planning services. Our award-winning firm has built a reputation for expressive, sustainable places to live, work, and gather.
BarlisWedlick is a group of passionate individuals dedicated to a spirit of creative collaboration and cooperation. As a member of our team, you will work with our tight-knit group of architects and designers on all phases of our projects, from early schematic design drawings, to construction documentation, and on through to project completion.
A well-rounded applicant must be able to demonstrate an understanding of high-end design, the ability to produce thoughtfully detailed construction drawings, and the skills to work on projects of varying size and scope.
We have an opening for an Intermediate Project Architect in our New York City office. Applicants must be willing and able to work from our office a minimum of 3 days a week (Tuesday-Thursday) with possible flexibility to work remotely on Monday and Friday. Applicants will also need to be willing and able to travel to the Hudson Valley and tristate area on occasion, as needs arise.
Our benefit package includes 2-weeks of paid vacation (to start), paid holidays (including office closure the last week of the year), a 401k plan, and medical, vision, and dental insurance. The salary range for this position is $75,000 – 88,000 per year, commensurate on experience and/or licensure status. Our firm’s leaders are dedicated to your professional development throughout your career and will support your career growth.
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Schematic design studies and design development documents
- Detailed construction and bid documents
- Coordination with consultants
- Construction administration including site meetings
Skills:
- Proven ability to meet deadlines
- Self-motivated/Self-starter
- Extremely detail oriented multi-tasker
- Problem solver and strategic thinker
Required qualifications and experience:
- 5 -7 years of professional experience
- Professional degree in architecture
- Excellent AutoCAD skills (we work almost exclusively in AutoCAD)
- Competency in Adobe and Microsoft Office programs
- Experience with SketchUp
- Ability to work on multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively
- Excellent critical thinking and communication skills
- Must be authorized to work in the US
BarlisWedlick is an equal opportunity employer. BW does not discriminate on the basis race, color, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, family, or parental status.
Applicants should email a cover letter, resume, and work samples in a single pdf file (10mb max) to [email protected], with the subject heading “Intermediate Architect 2026 - NYC”.
While each application will be reviewed, due to the high volume of applicants, we will not be able to confirm receipt of individual applications.
We look forward to hearing from you!
